content: At present, the development of vector space models for textual data is one of the areas that has attracted the most research interest in natural language processing. This interest is motivated by the desire to move away from simple counts and weights of words, towards representations which can preserve word context and linguistic features of human speech. Studies find that these approaches are not only intuitively desirable, but also increase classification accuracy in machine learning tasks.
